neighbours.label: A comparator pointing an amount downward: 'less than', 'as low as', 'still lower', 'under $60'
fire: After the new windows went in, our heating bill fell to less than half.
The price of the ticket dropped from $80 to $50 and then lower still.
You can now buy a basic tablet for as low as $35 online.
Rents in the district have sunk even lower since the plant closed.
A used bike here can go for under $60 most of the year.
Membership was cut from 900 to fewer than 200 in a decade.
The cost of solar panels fell to less than a dollar per watt.
Phones with this chip sell for as low as $99 during the sale.
